node.title: Re: Variable scope issue- effect of "my" on hash ref keys, values
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I am disturbed by the fact that "extra fun" does not make into the Dumper output

I'm pretty sure that's because my $x->{a}->[0] = "no you don't!"; is mostly equivalent to my $x; $x->{a}->[0] = "no you don't!";. From [doc://perlsub#Private-Variables-via-my()]:

All listed elements must be legal lvalues. ... The my is simply a modifier on something you might assign to.
